question.text: The 'break-up value' or salvage-value method is MOST appropriate for which company type?

answer.text: A distressed company without a future business case

explanation.text: The Logic: The chapter states break-up value 'is used to value a company that is in distress or does not have a future business case' - it considers salvage if the business were shut down on valuation day. The Trap: Growth SaaS is DCF. Mature FMCG is multiples. Banks are NAV-based (asset-heavy financial). Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C, XV, X-B all test scenario-appropriate valuation method. Manager's Pro-Tip: Cat III distressed-debt strategies use break-up (liquidation) value as the LGD anchor in recovery modelling; for performing credits, EV/EBITDA floors apply.
